It is scheduled to be deployed this October at the Ant forest Kubuqi desert tree-planting site. The green planet exhibition showcases technological exploration in desertification control, marine conservation, green energy, and computing power through technology exhibits and global nature restoration case studies.

items.title: Finnish minister and influencer share their impressions of CIFIT
items.description: The 26th China International Fair for Investment and Trade (CIFIT) is being held in Xiamen, East China's Fujian province, from Sept 8 to 11. Finland, serving as a Guest Country of Honor for the first time, set up the Finland National Pavilion focusing on fields such as the circular economy, the energy transition, smart manufacturing, industrial digitalization, healthy living, and educational innovation. Let's hear from Sakari Puisto, Finland's Minister of Economic Affairs, and Finnish influencer Rebekka Mikkola as they share their impressions of CIFIT.
